text:
alex (People Ops): Heads-up 1 candidate (Staff ML Infra) has a med restriction: cannot stand for long periods and prefers minimal walking between meeting rooms. Needs a single-floor itinerary if possible. Can we consolidate panels to one floor and reserve an accessible workstation? cc @rachel @noah
rachel (Recruiter): Thanks. Most interviews are on 3rd floor but we can move 1:1s to the main floor and use Conf A+B adjacent to lobby. Noah, would that work for your panel?
noah (Hiring Manager): Yes, moving to main floor is fine. I'll ask interviewers to meet in Conf A. Also can we provide a low-profile chair and adjust camera height for comfort?
it-support-bot: AV/Ergonomics request ticket created: IT-7721. Please provide laptop spec and any driver access.
alex (People Ops): I'll mark the calendar invite: "Accessibility needs: minimal walking, accessible chair, single-floor plan" and attach an office map with route to conf rooms. Also reserving 'Quiet Corner' seating in Conf A for breaks.
rachel (Recruiter): Candidate arriving by train 9:50am; prefer start at 10:30 to allow check-in and a 20-minute seat-rest. Will book front-desk escort.
noah (Hiring Manager): I'll block 10:30-1:30 for panel and leave buffer after for debrief. Interviewers, please avoid standing demos.
alex (People Ops): Logistics note: hotel not needed. Parking voucher offered if candidate drives. Expense reminder: parking voucher up to $35; meals covered per candidate hospitality policy. Use code "cand-2148" for bookkeeping.
it-support-bot: Accessible workstation reserved in Reception area (adapter kit included). IT-7721 updated.
rachel (Recruiter): Confirmed with candidate; they appreciate the adjustments. Sending calendar invite now with map, escort info, and note about short breaks.
alex (People Ops): Closing: escorts, accessible chair, one-floor schedule, IT ticket created. If any changes, ping me. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
